name: MarketPredictor
summary: MarketPredictor is an Expert Advisor that uses machine learning-based prediction models to forecast market direction and generate trading signals. It likely employs pattern recognition or statistical modeling on historical price data to predict future price movements, executing trades based on its predictive confidence. The EA opens positions autonomously when its model signals sufficient probability of a directional move.
summary_zh: MarketPredictor是一个基于机器学习预测模型来预测市场方向并生成交易信号的智能交易系统。它利用历史价格数据进行模式识别或统计建模来预测未来价格走势，当模型预测置信度足够高时自动开仓交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用机器学习方法对市场进行预测，核心策略是通过分析历史价格模式来预测未来走势。入场条件基于预测模型的输出信号，当模型判断价格上涨或下跌的概率超过一定阈值时开仓。出场条件可能包括固定的止盈止损、反向预测信号或时间衰减退出机制。仓位管理方面，由于文件为二进制格式无法确认具体参数，但通常此类EA会提供手数或风险比例的输入参数。资金管理方面，机器学习型EA通常依赖回测拟合的参数，存在过拟合风险。该策略的创新点在于使用数据驱动的预测而非传统技术指标，但模型的泛化能力和实盘适应性是关键挑战。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs machine learning methods to predict market direction, with the core strategy analyzing historical price patterns to forecast future movements. Entry conditions are based on the predictive model's output signals, opening positions when the model determines the probability of price rising or falling exceeds a certain threshold. Exit conditions likely include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, reverse prediction signals, or time-decay exit mechanisms. Position sizing details cannot be confirmed due to the binary file format, but such EAs typically provide lot size or risk ratio input parameters. Money management in ML-based EAs often relies on backtest-fitted parameters, carrying significant overfitting risk. The innovation lies in data-driven prediction rather than traditional technical indicators, but model generalization and live trading adaptability remain key challenges.

pros: 采用机器学习方法，数据驱动的决策比传统指标更灵活
能够捕捉非线性价格模式，适应复杂市场环境
预测概率输出提供了置信度参考，可过滤低质量信号
pros_en: Machine learning approach provides data-driven decisions more flexible than traditional indicators
Capable of capturing non-linear price patterns, adapting to complex market environments
Prediction probability output offers confidence reference, filtering low-quality signals
cons: 机器学习模型存在严重过拟合风险，回测表现可能无法复制到实盘
源码为二进制格式，无法审计核心算法逻辑和交易安全性
缺乏对市场状态切换的适应性，模型在结构变化时可能持续亏损
cons_en: Machine learning models carry severe overfitting risk; backtest performance may not replicate in live trading
Source code is in binary format, making it impossible to audit core algorithm logic and trading safety
Lacks adaptability to market regime changes; the model may sustain losses during structural shifts
improvements: 增加市场状态识别机制，在不同市场环境下切换或调整预测模型
引入walk-forward验证和样本外测试，减少过拟合风险
improvements_en: Add market regime detection to switch or adjust prediction models under different market conditions
Introduce walk-forward validation and out-of-sample testing to reduce overfitting risk
